Facial fat transfers, also known as fat grafting or fat injections, are advanced procedures used to restore volume, enhance facial contours, and improve overall facial aesthetics. At AestheticEye in Cincinnati, OH, our board-certified oculoplastic surgeons, Dr. Ginger Henson and Dr. Jonathan Pargament, specialize in facial fat transfers, particularly in relation to reconstructive and cosmetic eye surgeries. Serving patients in Cincinnati, Dayton, our team is dedicated to providing personalized care and exceptional results.

The Benefits of Fat Transfer Surgery at AestheticEye

Facial fat transfers offer a natural solution to volume loss, allowing for the restoration of youthful contours and the correction of asymmetries. The procedure uses your body’s own fat, which is harvested from areas like the abdomen or thighs, purified, and then injected into the target areas of the face.

How Facial Fat Transfers Enhance Reconstructive Eye Surgeries

Facial fat transfers are particularly beneficial when used in conjunction with reconstructive eye surgeries. They can help address volume loss around the eyes, improve the results of eyelid surgeries, and enhance overall facial harmony.

Restoring Volume

Fat grafting can replenish lost volume in the periocular area, providing a more balanced and youthful appearance.

Enhancing Eyelid Reconstruction

Fat transfers can complement eyelid reconstruction by filling in hollow areas and smoothing transitions between different facial regions.

Improving Facial Symmetry

Fat injections can correct asymmetries that may result from trauma or previous surgeries.

The Facial Fat Transfer Procedure

At AestheticEye, our surgeons utilize advanced techniques to ensure the best possible outcomes for facial fat transfers. The procedure involves several key steps:

Consultation and Evaluation

During your initial consultation, Dr. Henson or Dr. Pargament will perform a thorough evaluation to understand your goals and assess the areas that would benefit from fat grafting. They will develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs.

Harvesting the Fat

The first step in the procedure is to harvest fat from a donor site, typically the abdomen or thighs. This is done using gentle liposuction techniques to minimize trauma to the fat cells.

Purifying the Fat

The harvested fat is then purified to remove any impurities and ensure that only healthy fat cells are used for the grafting process.

Injecting the Fat

The purified fat is carefully injected into the target areas of the face using fine cannulas. Our surgeons use precise techniques to ensure even distribution and natural-looking results.

Recovery and Results

Recovery from facial fat transfer is generally smooth, with most patients experiencing mild swelling and bruising for the first week or two. The results of fat grafting are long-lasting, providing a natural enhancement to your facial contours and overall appearance.

Frequently Asked Questions | Facial Fat Transfers

How Long Do the Results of Facial Fat Transfers Last?

The results of facial fat transfers can be long-lasting, often several years. Unlike synthetic fillers, which are eventually absorbed by the body, the transferred fat cells can integrate with the surrounding tissues and provide lasting volume.

Can Facial Fat Transfers Be Combined with Other Procedures?

Yes, facial fat transfers can be combined with other procedures, such as eyelid reconstruction or facelifts, to achieve more comprehensive results. Combining treatments can enhance overall facial harmony and improve the aesthetic outcome.

What Are the Advantages of Using My Own Fat for Injections?

Using your own fat for injections has several advantages, including a lower risk of allergic reactions and a more natural look and feel compared to synthetic fillers. Additionally, fat grafting can provide a dual benefit by contouring the donor site through liposuction.

Is the Fat Transfer Procedure Painful?

The procedure is performed under local anesthesia, so you will not feel pain during the injections. Post-operative discomfort is usually minimal and can be managed with over-the-counter pain medications.

How Soon Will I See the Results of Fat Grafting?

Initial results can be seen immediately after the procedure, although some swelling and bruising may be present. The final results become more apparent as the swelling subsides, typically within a few weeks.

Are There Any Risks Associated with Facial Fat Transfers?

As with any surgical procedure, there are potential risks, including infection, uneven results, and fat resorption. These risks are minimized when the procedure is performed by experienced oculoplastic surgeons like Dr. Henson and Dr. Pargament at AestheticEye.
